task: Fix mobile scroll lock and flexbox layout clipping
context: The application currently has a global 'overflow: hidden' on the body and html tags, which completely disables vertical scrolling on mobile devices. Additionally, the centered flexbox layout causes the top of tall elements to be clipped off-screen when they overflow the viewport.
instructions: Inside this media query, add a rule for `html, body, #root` to forcefully unlock scrolling. Apply `height: auto !important`, `min-height: 100vh`, `overflow-y: auto !important`, `overflow-x: hidden !important`, and `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`.

Inside the same media query, add a rule for `body` to fix the flexbox clipping issue. Set `align-items: center !important` and `justify-content: flex-start !important` so the layout starts from the top edge rather than getting trapped above the screen.
Inside the same media query, add a rule for `.app-wrapper` to restore vertical centering dynamically now that the body is top-aligned. Apply `margin: auto 0;` and `padding: 40px 20px;`.
expected_outcome: The user should be able to smoothly scroll up and down on mobile devices without any content getting permanently trapped or clipped off the top or bottom of the screen.
